description: Manage Alibaba Cloud (Aliyun) after-sales support tickets from the conversation: match the reported problem against the published ticket rules, build a redacted non-blocking draft, then query the product catalog, list recent tickets, create, view, reply to, close and rate tickets through the Workorder OpenAPI. Use when a customer asks to open, follow up on, reply to, close or rate an Alibaba Cloud support ticket, asks for the ticket list, status or engineer reply, or wants human support instead of self-service. Triggers: "submit a ticket", "create a support ticket", "list my tickets", "view ticket status", "reply to the engineer", "close the ticket", "rate the ticket", "transfer to human support", "escalate to Alibaba Cloud support", "support case". Do not use for product knowledge, troubleshooting or solution discussion that carries no ticket intent.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
